Klasse App

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
org.golfit.client.App
public class App extends javafx.application.Application
JavaFX application entry point for the GolfIt client. Sets up the primary stage with a splash screen, sidebar, and game view, and manages transitions between lobby and game states.
